valuation.method: Forward-to-target EPS x justified P/E on FY2027 non-GAAP EPS (fiscal year ends about 1 Nov, so FY2027 is complete at the Nov 2027 target date and the multiple is applied to a trailing-at-target figure; the investor at that date is pricing FY2028, which is not sourced here). FY2026 non-GAAP EPS is built from reported quarters: Q1 $2.46 (MarketBeat summary of the 18 Feb 2026 release; press-release table not opened), Q2 $3.09 (8-K, 20 May 2026), Q3 $3.45 (19 Aug 2026 release), Q4 guidance midpoint $3.86 (+/- $0.15), totalling about $12.86. FY2027 EPS working consensus of roughly $14.6-$15.0 comes from third-party previews (Barchart, Yahoo analysis page), not a company figure. The listing is the USD Nasdaq share, so no FX conversion is needed. Bear, base and bull EPS and multiples are model assumptions, not company guidance.

bear.driver: AI data-center and power demand slows after the FY2026 run-rate; industrial and auto recovery stalls and gross margin gives back part of the Q3 gain; the multiple de-rates as the stock is treated as a cyclical peak

base.driver: Q4 guide ($3.86) and the Q3 bookings trend carry into FY2027 at about 18% EPS growth; data-center and industrial mix keeps non-GAAP operating margin near the guided 52%; buybacks and the $4.40 dividend run in line with FY2026
base.assumption: FY2027 EPS $15.00 (midpoint of the $14.6-$15.0 working consensus) at 25x

bull.driver: AI and data-center bookings keep compounding through FY2027 with analog pricing firm; margin expansion beyond the guided range; the multiple holds near 28x on a visible growth runway
bull.assumption: FY2027 EPS $17.50 (near the top of the third-party range, about 36% growth) at 28x

valuation.implied_by_close: At the base EPS of $15.00 the close of $397.97 implies 26.5x FY2027 EPS, about 1.5 turns above the 25x base multiple. The Yahoo Finance aggregate mean of $473.42 (33 analysts, median $470) implies about 31.6x base EPS, or about $18.90 of EPS at 25x, which is above the top of the working consensus; the sources do not show whether the panel is using FY2028 EPS or a higher multiple.
valuation.sensitivity: One turn of P/E moves the base target by $15.00 (about 3.8 pp of the close). A $1.00 change in FY2027 EPS at 25x moves the base target by $25.00 (about 6.3 pp).
valuation.watch_metric: FY2027 non-GAAP EPS guidance and the Q1 FY2027 adjusted EPS guide, against the roughly $3.86 Q4 run-rate. A Q1 FY2027 guide that implies FY2027 below about $14.60 would weaken the base case; guidance above about $15.50 with the data-center mix holding would support a move toward the bull case.
valuation.next_disclosure: Q4 and full-year FY2026 results and FY2027 outlook, Tuesday 24 Nov 2026 at 7:00 a.m. ET (company release notice dated 22 Oct 2026).

analyst_notes: Partial panel of six named-firm views: Bernstein upgraded to Outperform with a target of $465 (from $430) after the Q3 beat, and KeyBanc ($525) and Raymond James ($430) are the other post-earnings-era calls. The 2026 raises from Needham ($440), JPMorgan ($450) and Bank of America ($425) sit below the $470 aggregate median, and most of the panel predates the 19 Aug Q3 release, so they carry stale-target risk. Cantor Fitzgerald ($510 on 13 May with an undated $550 reported later), Wells Fargo ($470 vs $515), Baird ($450 vs an unverified $675) and a BMO initiation were excluded because the successor calls could not be dated or verified against a primary source. No event has a documented 12-month horizon, so none enters the weighted target; the Yahoo aggregate (33 analysts, mean $473.42) is context only and not used in the valuation.
